remarks: Tri-level townhouse within close proximity to downtown Stamford, train and Stamford Hospital. This condo offers 3 bedrooms and 2.5 baths. Two car attached garage and on-street parking. Kitchen with granite counters and stainless steel appliances. Some of the newer updates include: fresh paint throughout most of the unit, high-end large Electrolux washer/dryer on the second floor, refrigerator and microwave plus more! Garage was currently being used as a home gym but can also be used as a garage featuring high-end black PVC tile flooring, upgraded lighting and a large mirrored wall. This unit features hardwood flooring, an oversized master suite on the third floor, two zone gas heat and large attic for storage.
